commit.message:
feat(app): set the part's X and Y in the work plane by an edge or two points

A setup alignment mode that turns the part about the setup's Z so a
picked straight edge, or two picked points, runs along +Y and/or +X.
The direction is read through the setup's current part alignment (so it
composes after a face-to-plane lay), projected into the setup's XY, and
optionally flipped. With both axes given the primary one (Y by default)
is laid exactly and the other is only checked (not parallel, not
left-handed); with one, the other follows right-handed (X = Y x Z).

- app: pick::axis (turn_in_plane, in_plane_turn_deg) feeding the
  existing undoable AlignPartToSetup (new turn_in_plane / check_turn
  doors): stock and linked setups follow, ops go stale, undo restores.
  Refused by name: a face, a closed or curved edge, one point,
  coincident points, a non-part pick, a direction near the plane
  normal, parallel or left-handed X/Y, nothing picked.
- ui: "Axes in the plane" rows on the setup page - per axis Edge / Two
  points, a pick toggle naming what it takes, Flip; Primary, Apply axes
  (greyed with the command's reason), Clear axes. The draft
  (crate::axis_pick) routes Edge / Vertex clicks; one draft collects at
  a time.
- mcp: set_part_axes, one undo step.
- docs/decisions/557-axis-by-edge.md.

Fixes #557

fix(ui): the setup page's plane alignment picks faces only

Picking a face for "Lay on a plane" kept snapping to an edge. The row
now arms Face mode ("Pick a face"), so a click beside an edge takes the
face. An edge cannot define a plane, so the #330 two-edge plane mode is
removed rather than left half-reachable: pick::lay_on_plane refuses an
edge pick by name ("an edge cannot set a plane; pick a flat face
(edges set an axis: Axes in the plane)"), and an edge or point that
reaches the plane draft is refused by name in the status line with the
face kept. The page says which pick each row takes: a face for the
plane, an edge or two points for an axis (#557). The 3-2-1 and
operation-geometry edge picking are unchanged.

Tests: a real viewport click 4 px inside a face beside its edge takes
the face with the plane row armed and the edge with an axis row armed;
edge picks refused by name (app and draft); the concave step and
winding tests now pin the face; structural setup-page rows.
docs/decisions/554-plane-pick-faces-only.md.

Fixes #554

feat(app,ui): lay the part on a plane through three picked points

Three model corners span a plane laid on the setup's G17/G18/G19 plane
through the face pick's own apply path (pick::plane::lay_datum), so a
face and three corners of it give the same alignment. The outside is
the side away from the part's material; Flip turns it. Optional 3-2-1
frame: point 1 to the origin, 1 -> 2 along +X (+Y for G19). One
undoable AlignPartToSetup (lay_on_points / check_points); refusals by
name: not three vertices, coincident (< 0.001 mm), (nearly) collinear
(< 1 degree of spread), off the part, no model. Setup page row "Lay on
a plane - pick three points" with point prompts, Remove last, Clear
points and a greyed Apply with the reason; MCP tool lay_part_on_points.

Fixes #555

fix(ui): laying a picked face on a plane turns the part

Reproduced through the real Setups page at the 1280 x 720 hand-test
window, the seed block turned 30 degrees about X. The turn itself was
right all along (pick::lay_on_plane + AlignPartToSetup, on main too);
what the user could reach was not:

- On main the "Lay on a plane" row armed Edge mode, so a click on the
  face took an edge and Apply stayed grey. #554 (7d641c8b, on this
  stack) already arms Face mode.
- The row was one long line, so Flip, "Face to plane level" and Apply
  (placed after "Picked: Face <19-digit id> of ...") ran past the
  properties pane's right edge, out of reach. The only Apply in reach
  was the Part alignment row's (a typed turn about the bounds centre).

The face row now uses short lines and its own "Apply face" button on a
line of its own; the three-points (#555) and axes-in-the-plane (#557)
rows, which overflowed the same way, get short lines too.

Pinned by ui egui_app::tests::plane_face_lay (a real click on a tilted
face, Flip, Apply face: the face ends -Z at Z 0 with the part above;
Ctrl+Z restores), structural::setup_page_alignment_rows_structure
(every option of the three rows on screen) and app plane_align
a_tilted_face_is_turned_flat_onto_each_plane_with_the_part_above_it
(G17/G18/G19 through the command, undo).

Fixes #330

feat(setups): part alignment turns about the WCS origin and lays the picked face down

The Setups page's Part alignment row's typed angles now turn the part
about the setup's WCS origin by default: the part's point on the origin
stays there (the maintainer's "it shifts the model relative to the
origin"). The row names its pivot in an "about [WCS origin | part
centre]" combo beside Apply, on a line of its own; "part centre" is
the old turn. The presets keep turning about the part's centre. One
undoable AlignPartToSetup (new AlignPartToSetup::turn, app::setup_turn).

"Lay on a plane" now lays a new pick face down: the face row's toggle
is "Face down" and the points row's "Points down", both on by default.
Only the UI draft's default changed - PlaneLay::flip, the MCP tools
and saved projects (which store the transform, not the flag) are
untouched.

setup_page_alignment_rows_structure asserts every alignment control
lies inside the properties pane's rect, not just the window; it fails
on the #330 one-line regression.

Stacked on #603. Decisions: docs/decisions/606-align-pivot.md.

Fixes #606
